About KTC TOWING

Calgary Towing Done Right

KTC Towing is a local Calgary towing and vehicle recovery company. We are based at 347 39 Ave SE, and our drivers know how a Calgary winter behaves: batteries that fail at -30, icy back roads that put cars in ditches, and the stress of finding a vehicle in the impound lot.

Our fleet is matched to the job. Flatbeds move vehicles with zero wheels on the road, wheel-lift trucks handle quick city tows, winch gear pulls vehicles out of snow and ditches, and heavy-duty trucks handle work vehicles, RVs and trailers. You get a clear quote first, an honest ETA, and a driver who explains each step.

  • Fast response, 20 min average

  • Upfront, fair pricing

Towing Calgary

Fast Tow Truck Service Across the Whole City

When you search for towing Calgary drivers can rely on, you want three things: a truck that arrives quickly, the right equipment for your vehicle, and a price that is clear before the hook-up. That is how KTC Towing runs every call.

Calgary is a big, spread-out city, and where you break down changes the job. A stalled car on Deerfoot Trail at rush hour is a safety problem, and our dispatcher will ask for your direction of travel and nearest exit so the driver can reach you fast. A car that will not start in a downtown parkade needs low-profile equipment. A vehicle slid into a snowbank on a Tuscany or Saddle Ridge side street needs winch gear, not just a standard tow. We handle all of these, 24 hours a day, from our base at 347 39 Ave SE.

Our tow truck Calgary team covers the main routes drivers use every day: Deerfoot Trail, Stoney Trail, Crowchild Trail, Glenmore Trail, Macleod Trail, the Trans-Canada Highway (Highway 1) and 16 Avenue NW. We also tow across the NE, NW, SE and SW quadrants, to and from the airport area, and out to Chestermere, Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks and High River.

Whether you need emergency towing in Calgary after an accident, a flatbed tow for an AWD or electric vehicle, a jump start on a freezing morning, or help getting your car out of the impound lot, one call to (587) 435-0770 is enough. We confirm the truck, the arrival time and the price before we dispatch.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a tow truck cost in Calgary?

Tows start at $50 CAD for a standard light-duty tow within Calgary. The final price depends on vehicle type, distance and time of day, and we give you a clear quote before the truck is dispatched. For heavy-duty, recovery or impound transport, we provide a custom estimate.

How do I get my car out of an impound lot in Calgary?

You typically need valid photo ID, proof of ownership, valid insurance, and payment for any outstanding impound and storage fees. Requirements vary by lot, so call the facility first. As an authorized recovery partner, KTC Towing can then transport your released vehicle wherever it needs to go.

How much does impound recovery cost?

Transport cost depends on the impound lot location and your destination. We quote you upfront before dispatch. Note that the impound facility charges its impound and daily storage fees separately.

How fast can a tow truck reach me?

Our average arrival time for emergency calls in Calgary is about 20 minutes, and we confirm your ETA before we hang up. Traffic and weather can affect timing.

Are you available 24/7?

Yes. KTC Towing dispatch is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, including holidays and long weekends. Call (587) 435-0770 or message us on WhatsApp any time, day or night.

Do you offer flatbed towing?

Yes, for luxury, lowered, AWD, electric, and damaged vehicles, for damage-free transport.

What areas do you serve?

All of Calgary, NE, NW, SE, and SW, plus Chestermere, Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks, and High River. We also offer long-distance towing across Alberta.

Can you pull my vehicle out of snow or a ditch?

Yes. Our winch-out and recovery service safely pulls vehicles from snow, mud, and ditches, common during Calgary winters.

What vehicles can you tow?

We tow almost everything on the road: cars, SUVs, minivans, pickup trucks, AWD and electric vehicles, lowered and luxury cars, and motorcycles. For bigger jobs, our heavy-duty trucks handle cube vans, work trucks, buses, RVs, travel trailers, and commercial vehicles.
